value.rationale: The full coordinate-sum and gap fluctuation geometry of both members of each rare comparable pair is a natural second-order invariant in high-dimensional partial orders, missing from prior unmarked count asymptotics. The marked Poisson process gives exact limiting joint extreme-event probabilities and exhibits nontrivial global extreme dependence despite asymptotically independent within-edge Gaussian center and gap. This is more than a count recomputation.
